text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2326 triggered: elevated 5xx rate and routing spillover observed between eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1. Pager to @Emma (oncall) and @Raj. Logs pinned to #incidents/2326000123.
Emma (oncall): I'm seeing the spike. Customers complaining about slow responses and occasional model mismatch (fallback to smaller variant). Is there a quick mitigation we can apply?
Raj (infra): Confirmed. High enqueue time on eu-west-1 serving pool. Autoscaler delayed due to healthcheck flaps from a subset of GPU nodes.
Sophie (runtime): We also saw unexpected model-variant selection: requests intended for model-redwood-13b-q converted to redwood-7b-compat. That explains quality regressions reported.
Maria (product): Which customers are impacted? Any enterprise tenants in EU with SLAs?
Emma (oncall): Affected customers: acorn-payments, atlas-search (both EU). They've opened support tickets. Severity P1.
ops-bot: Summary: 5xx rate + 99th latency up. Routing policy attempted regional spillover -> fallback model variant applied for 18% of traffic. See attached trace links.
Raj (infra): Initial hypothesis: a small subset of eu-west nodes were failing health checks, triggering spillover. Spillover routing policy has tiebreak to lower-tier model variant when capacity is short. Need to know whether the healthcheck failures were flapping or sustained.
Sophie (runtime): Pulling node health logs now. Sharing recent tail of scheduler logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:01:12Z scheduler: node gpu-eu-west-12 healthcheck FAIL (nvml timeout)
2026-03-15T09:01:15Z scheduler: node gpu-eu-west-12 healthcheck PASS
2026-03-15T09:01:20Z scheduler: node gpu-eu-west-12 healthcheck FAIL (OOM-evict)
2026-03-15T09:02:02Z routing: pool eu-west-1 capacity drop -3
2026-03-15T09:02:05Z routing: spillover invoked -> eu-central-1
```
Raj (infra): Looks like transient nvml timeouts + OOM on that host. Could be an outlier. We should cordon gpu-eu-west-12 and let autoscaler replace it.
Emma (oncall): For immediate mitigation can we tweak spillover policy to prefer same-region degraded-tier instead of cross-region? Cross-region introduced higher latency and forced fallback variants.
Sophie (runtime): The routing policy is dynamic but controlled by infra. Quick patch: reduce cross-region spillover weight and disable variant downgrade for the next 20 minutes. I'll draft a safe config and run a canary.
Raj (infra): Pushing canary now to routing control plane (config id rc-2326-temp). Command:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://controlplane.internal/configs/rc-2326-temp -d '{"spillover_policy": "prefer-local-degraded", "allow_variant_downgrade": false}'
```
deploy-bot: config rc-2326-temp applied to 10% of traffic in eu-west-1 canary. Monitoring.
Emma (oncall): Noted. Can someone paste the canary metrics? Need 5xx, p99, fallback-rate.
Sophie (runtime): Canary metrics after 2 minutes:
- 5xx: down from 6.8% -> 1.9%
- p99 latency: down from 3.2s -> 1.4s
- fallback-rate: down from 18% -> 2.5%
Sophie (runtime): Looks promising. Roll to 100% over next 5m.
Raj (infra): Rolling now. Also cordoning gpu-eu-west-12 to prevent further flaps: `kubectl annotate node gpu-eu-west-12 cordoned-by=inc-2326` and creating replacement.
Maria (product): Alerted the two impacted customers: acorn-payments and atlas-search. Told them we have a mitigation and working on RCA. They asked for timeline and whether model outputs were affected. Emma: can we provide an estimate? Any corrupted outputs?
Sophie (runtime): Variant downgrade likely caused lower-quality outputs, not corruption. Suggest sending a sample diff for each tenant. I can run a quick rerun of recent 50 requests against the pinned model to show delta.
Emma (oncall): Good. Also collect telemetry: request_id list, original routing decision logs, KV cache hits. Add kube events.
ops-bot: Collecting artifacts: uploaded scheduler logs, routing traces, node metrics to s3://redwood-incidents/2326000123/artifacts.tar.gz
Raj (infra): Hypotheses to track in-thread:
- H1: Node-level OOM/nvml flaps caused capacity drop -> spillover -> variant downgrade (primary)
- H2: Routing control-plane bug mis-evaluated capacity and triggered cross-region spillover prematurely
- H3: Autoscaler delay combined with spike in short-lived requests created temporary coldstart pressure
Sophie (runtime): I'm assigning quick tests:
- Test A: Replay 30s of production traffic in staging with a single node failure to reproduce spillover.
- Test B: Run routing decision unit test to ensure downgrade only when capacity=0, not degraded.
Raj (infra): Working on Test A now. Snapshot of node metrics during failure attached. Also checking kernel logs for OOM-killer.
Emma (oncall): Timeline so far (please edit):
- 09:00:39 - small spike in request rate across eu-west-1
- 09:01:12 - gpu-eu-west-12 healthcheck FAIL
- 09:02:05 - routing spillover invoked to eu-central-1
- 09:03:40 - fallback model applied for subset of requests
- 09:05:10 - canary routing patch applied
- 09:07:00 - 100% patch rollout complete and metrics improving
Sophie (runtime): Adding a note: fallback-selection code path uses `select_variant_by_latency_then_capacity()` which has a bug when capacity_percent < 10 it auto-downgrades. I can prepare a PR to change threshold and add tests.
Maria (product): For customer comms, we need a short summary and ETA for RCA. Can we commit to a timeline?
Emma (oncall): Plan: immediate mitigation done. RCA draft by EOD. Full remediation (config + tests + node replacement + patch) by EOD +1. I'll take owner for RCA.
Raj (infra): I'll follow up with node forensic + autoscaler logs. Tagging @Sophie for the runtime patch.
Sophie (runtime): PR coming up: runtime/select_variant: change threshold from 10 -> 3 and add integration test; will link when open.
ops-bot: Incident 2326 status: mitigation applied, monitoring for regression. Next update in 30 min or on new findings.
Emma (oncall): Thanks all. If you find new anomalies drop them here. After this thread we'll convert to postmortem doc and attach timeline + artifacts.
Maria (product): Thx. I'll update customers and create follow-up template for impacted tenants.
Raj (infra): FYI I'll keep node cordoned until replacement is ready. Will include kernel oops if present in forensic.
Sophie (runtime): Pushing PR now -> https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/9876 :shipit:
Emma (oncall): Closing live mitigation loop. Moving to RCA coordination channel after 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:
